title: Fair NLP Models with Differentially Private Text Encoders

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-gap) between texts associated with African American English (AAE) and Standard American English (SAE) speakers on a Twitter sentiment analysis task.

Measuring the root mean square of True Positive Rate gaps (GRMS) across multiple occupation classes in the Bias in Bios dataset, as well as evaluating TPR-gaps between binary gender groups on the CelebA (smiling prediction) and Adult Income classification datasets.
